title: Warm and Hearty Croatian Turkey Ham Tagine
description: A comforting and kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring turkey ham, soffritto-base, and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients. Serve warm over fluffy couscous.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay tajine over medium heat.
Add the chopped soffritto and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced turkey ham and cook until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the canned diced tomatoes and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the tajine and cook for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped parsley, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the warm tagine over fluffy couscous, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving, allowing the flavors to meld together.
